purpose: Convert black-hole thermodynamics/Mpemba heuristics into separable analytic, theory, observation and falsification routes without promoting analogy to evidence.
epistemic_invariants: holographic or Unruh Mpemba precedent != astrophysical black-hole Mpemba detection
static Tolman temperature != freely falling thermometer reading
jet launching outside the horizon != matter escaping from inside the horizon
failed descendants are quarantined, not deleted

mpemba_operational_definition.distance: D[X(t),X_eq] must be fixed before inspecting the claimed crossing
mpemba_operational_definition.anti_post_hoc_rule: epsilon, observable, preprocessing and covariance treatment must be preregistered for a real-data claim
mpemba_operational_definition.mode_probe: compare overlap/amplitude of the slowest relaxation mode; suppression is a candidate mechanism, not a detection by itself

claim_ledger.claim: For Schwarzschild, T_H is proportional to M^-1, S_BH to M^2 and C_BH is negative.
Static Tolman near-horizon temperature equals the freely falling local thermometer reading.
Past, present and future form one locally measured thermodynamic state at the horizon.
Observed jets consist of material emitted from inside the event horizon.
Magnetized exterior plasma and black-hole spin/flux are relevant standard jet-launching mechanisms.
An astrophysical black hole has a directly observed Mpemba relaxation.
Mpemba-like relaxation has relativistic-QFT and holographic precedents.
Hawking temperature has been directly measured for M87* or Sgr A*.
Generic curved spacetime always supplies one globally conserved scalar energy for the complete system.

falsifiers.criterion: dT_H/dM < 0; C_BH < 0; T_H(2M)/T_H(M)=1/2; S_BH(2M)/S_BH(M)=4 in Schwarzschild semiclassical domain
observer class explicit; static expression rejects r<=r_s
reject any route requiring causal transport from inside the horizon to infinity
confront exterior jet models with horizon-scale polarimetry/jet-base morphology and standard GRMHD/force-free competitors
matched time series satisfy far initial distance, crossing and faster first-passage conditions
effect survives covariance, uncertainty propagation, admissible monotone distances, hold-out and look-elsewhere controls
mode suppression/ablation supports the mechanism where a mode decomposition is meaningful
never use EHT synchrotron/plasma observables as Hawking-temperature measurement
